scientific_integrity: Proof and standalone direct small-n checker are provided; finite verification is corroboration, not a proof of arbitrary n.
scientific_limitations: Formal generating series for n>=5 only; uses structural classification and minimal-generator theorem from Gould–Grau–Johnson; no n<=4 claim; unindexed equivalent enumerations remain possible.
title: Euler-transform generator-rank formula for endomorphism monoids of full transformation semigroups
